scope: Public form URLs and per-embed appearance in WordPress, Joomla, Wix and shared HTML embed
result: Presentation override is public per-embed behavior, not permission to persist form settings

checks.adapter_url_validation: Fixed product origin and public /form/ slug; rejects admin URLs, arbitrary origins, query/hash injection
checks.host_messages: iframe source, exact origin and random instance match
checks.child_messages: actual parent window, HTTP(S) origin pinned by initialization, protocol/instance checks
checks.theme: Bounded allowlisted presentation properties validated with CSS.supports; bounded HTTP(S) font resources; no arbitrary CSS/script/markup
checks.persistence: EmbedTheme only updates current document styles/fonts; no RPC/database writes
checks.form_authorization: update_form_internal_v1 requires service role or can_author_forms(occasion), binds stored form to occasion

behavior_limit: A public link permits another host to choose appearance for its own embedded copy. Saved form default is not a host-domain appearance lock. This review does not claim origin allowlisting of embedders.
